scope: All dyadic grid sizes and valid node indices; rational punctured products and pointwise valuation only. No chart-content, uniform mode bound, recursion, ECDLP or novelty theorem.
statement: For all natural a,k with k<2^(a+1) and all nonzero rational w, padicValRat2(w*w/cauchyRho a k)=2*padicValRat2w, with the exact shifted-grid normalizer defined and its unit property proved.
